notablePrerequisites:
You have a card with an ability that only costs mana and that can repeatedly target Emrakul.
Lands you control can tap to produce {2} plus enough mana to activate the aforementioned ability.
description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding an amount of mana.
Activate a card's ability by paying its cost, targeting Emrakul.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Emrakul.
The ability from step 2 fizzles due to having no legal target.
Cast Emrakul from exile by paying {2}.
Emrakul triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
